address: 27 Princess Street, Plymouth, PL1 2EX, United Kingdom
bio: It may be just around the corner from the Theatre Royal, but this warmly run restaurant is so much more than a convenient spot to eat in before curtain-up. From the good value lunch menu to the à la carte, the eponymous chef-owner, who is a local himself, knows how to cater for all tastes – and it’s clear that plenty of care and attention go into every dish....
